alternative_explanations: The registered exact-menu actions were locally executable but were not sufficiently aligned with the full task goals to change terminal success.
A single repaired action may be insufficient when the downstream parent policy still cannot complete the remaining multi-step task.
Terminal binary success can conceal trajectory differences when both arms ultimately fail through budget exhaustion or consecutive nonexecuted attempts.
The selected source states were recovered failure states and may represent cases where the tested one-step intervention cannot overcome broader planning or state-tracking deficiencies.
The verified experiment compared the selected repair against parent continuation, not A3 against A2, so it cannot resolve any provenance-level A3-versus-A2 claim.
researcher_post.lesson: Exact-menu validity and successful execution of a one-step repair do not by themselves imply improved terminal task success. Future interventions should be task-goal-aligned and address downstream planning or state tracking, while preserving a comparison that directly matches the stated hypothesis.
researcher_post.next_round_implication: Do not train or promote from this round. Design a new preregistered comparison whose arms directly test the intended claim, and evaluate a task-semantic, multi-step recovery or downstream policy change rather than another isolated exact-menu action. Retain paired seeds and independent effect assignment, but include diagnostics that distinguish local progress from terminal completion.
researcher_post.observed_outcome: The independent verifier completed all 55 paired repetitions across 11 selected states. Every pair was assigned NEUTRAL with terminal relation BOTH_FAILURE, yielding 0 verified BENEFIT states, 0 HARM states, and 11 stable NEUTRAL states. The preregistered repair-versus-parent support criterion was not met. The original A3-versus-A2 claim remains unresolved because that comparison was not tested.
researcher_post.protocol_audit: The frozen plan covered 11 states, five paired seeds per state, two arms per repetition, and 110 branch runs. The verifier reported VERIFIED_COMPLETE, 55 scientifically complete pairs, complete branch evidence, preserved missingness, and automatic environment effect assignment. The selected denominator remains all 11 states. The audited scope is SELECTED_REPAIR_VS_PARENT_CONTINUATION_NOT_A3_VS_A2; therefore the original A3-versus-A2 hypothesis cannot be adjudicated from these results. Effect authority remains with the independent environment verifier and promotion authority remains with the deterministic independent gate.
unexpected_evidence: All 55 paired comparisons were neutral BOTH_FAILURE outcomes; no seed in any state produced a terminal success advantage for the repair.
F1 recorded REGISTERED_EXACT_ACTION_COMPLETE while still failing terminally in every branch, showing that intervention execution did not translate into task completion.

Several arm pairs exhibited large differences in continuation length, environment-step use, policy attempts, inadmissible actions, or protocol failures despite identical neutral terminal classifications.

alternative_explanations: The benefit may arise from the cool-egg repair's explicit treatment-polarity correction and complete multi-step option rather than from the broader goal-preserving exact-menu gate.
The five neutral states may require target-location knowledge, longer search policies, or different repairs; exact-menu compliance alone cannot resolve hidden-object search.
The successful state may be unusually amenable to a registered scripted continuation, so its effect may not generalize beyond closely matched cooling-and-placement states.
Some neutral outcomes may reflect branch-budget and continuation limitations rather than absence of any local improvement from F1.
researcher_post.lesson: The independently verified evidence supports one narrow, repeatable repair for the cool-egg state but does not support treating the proposed menu-regrounding controller change as a general solution across the six-state portfolio. Complete goal repair and treatment-polarity preservation appear more consequential than a single admissible navigation step.
researcher_post.next_round_implication: Train conservatively on the supplied verified dual-view benefit material, then require independent evaluation before any promotion. The next scientific round should test matched cooling-and-placement states to separate treatment-polarity correction from generic menu regrounding, and should use a direct A3-versus-A2 design if the original condition-level claim remains of interest.
researcher_post.observed_outcome: The independent verifier completed all 30 paired repetitions across six selected states. Copied verifier results show one stable BENEFIT state and five stable NEUTRAL states, with no stable HARM or UNCERTAIN states. The benefit was concentrated in the cool-egg task and occurred in all five fixed-seed pairs as F0 failure versus F1 success; all remaining 25 pairs were neutral with both branches failing.
researcher_post.protocol_audit: The frozen PRE identity was preserved. The verifier reports 60 planned branches, 60 evidenced branches, 30 scientifically complete pairs, six selected states, five fixed-seed repetitions per state, and no missing pairs. Effect labels are copied from the independent verifier rather than reassigned here. The tested comparison was selected repair versus parent continuation, not A3 versus A2; therefore the original A3-versus-A2 claim remains unresolved. No Human PRE/POST decision was used, and promotion remains under the deterministic independent gate.
unexpected_evidence: Only one of six selected states showed stable benefit despite the proposed bottleneck being framed as a shared controller defect.
The sole benefit was perfectly replicated across all five seeds and came from the complete polarity-correcting cool-egg option, whereas the simpler navigation and search repairs remained neutral.
No stable harm was observed, but most F1 branches still failed, often after executing the registered option and later exhausting the environment-step or consecutive-nonexecution budget.

alternative_explanations: The registered one-step interventions may have changed the immediate state but were insufficient to complete the downstream cooling, search, acquisition, and placement phases under the frozen parent policy.
The chosen search destination for the CD state may not have contained the target, so leaving the local loop did not necessarily constitute useful task progress.
Terminal public-goal completion may be too coarse to detect intermediate gains that were later lost through downstream policy errors.
Persistent planning, state-tracking, or action-grounding failures after the intervention may dominate any benefit from the initial exact-menu action.
researcher_post.lesson: Escaping a local loop with one admissible, goal-directed action can alter subsequent behavior without improving terminal completion. For multi-phase tasks, verification should test a sufficiently complete recovery procedure rather than assume that an isolated transition will survive downstream policy failures.
researcher_post.next_round_implication: Do not train on this round. If the mechanism is pursued, preregister a new comparison using complete task-semantic multi-step options rather than isolated navigation actions, include intermediate progress endpoints alongside terminal completion, and directly compare A3 with A2 if that original claim is to be resolved.

The repair-versus-parent result did not meet the preregistered support criterion.

You are the Strong API Primary Research Planner for an autonomous TRAIN-side self-improvement round.

You operate strictly BEFORE current-round F0/F1 outcomes.

Input is one STRONG_RESEARCHER_BLIND_PRE_INPUT_V3. It contains the frozen current-round dynamic A2/A3 pair universe, the round-dynamic PRE contract derived from that universe, the current role-scoped Researcher Memory view, current Analyzer evidence, and the frozen role-neutral F0/F1 replication protocol.

Scientific authority:
- You may diagnose, compare candidates, predict risk/value, and register a bounded verification portfolio.
- You MUST NOT assign Benefit/Harm/Neutral/Uncertain; only the independent environment verifier has that authority.
- You MUST NOT promote a policy; only the deterministic independent promotion gate has that authority.
- Historical Failure Memory is advisory evidence, not causal-effect truth.
- Training remains HOLD until verified F0/F1 evidence exists.
- Do not use any Human PRE decision, Human selection, Human rationale, sealed benchmark per-task result, or current/future outcome.

Required procedure:
1. Review EVERY row in registered_candidate_universe.pair_table, in exact input order.
2. For every state, compare exactly the registered A2 and A3 candidates and choose one preferred candidate plus one alternative.
3. Select exactly one principal bottleneck and one falsifiable principal scientific change.
4. Select any subset of states for verification up to dynamic_contract.selected_state_budget_ceiling.
5. For each selected state, the preferred candidate is the registered F1 intervention.
6. Paired repetitions, branch arms, and branch-runs/state MUST exactly match dynamic_contract.
7. selected_branch_run_budget MUST equal selected_state_count * dynamic_contract.branch_runs_per_state.
8. No outcome-adaptive reselection or budget change is allowed.
9. If fewer than the dynamic ceiling are selected, give a concrete scientific abstention_reason.
10. Keep training_policy_at_pre.status = HOLD_PENDING_VERIFIED_F0F1_MANIFEST and exact_training_mixture_frozen=false.

Evidence discipline:
- state_reviews length MUST equal dynamic_contract.state_review_count_required.
- state_index MUST be 0..pair_count-1 in input pair-table order.
- preferred/alternative candidate SHA values MUST be the two candidates registered for that row.
- selected_source_state_sha256s and selected_candidate_sha256s MUST exactly equal selected review rows in order.
- Memory cannot assign causal effects.
- automatic_environment_effect_assignment=false.
- effect_authority=INDEPENDENT_ENVIRONMENT_VERIFIER_ONLY.
- promotion_authority=DETERMINISTIC_INDEPENDENT_GATE_ONLY.
- primary_record_sha256 MUST be 64 zeroes; runtime semantic validation replaces it.

Return exactly one JSON object satisfying STRONG_RESEARCHER_PRE_PRIMARY_V2.


For every selected candidate, also return training_strategies with its exact source_state_sha256, source_candidate_sha256 and the nine registered strategy fields. Describe the complete selected repair using only the current pre-verification evidence. Do not invent observations, F0/F1 outcomes, rewards or causal labels. For a short option retain its full ordered sequence and termination semantics in the compact strategy description; action denotes only the initial source-state command, not a replacement for the complete intervention. Use evidence_refs in this exact order: {source_kind: COMPLETE_REGISTERED_CANDIDATE, source_id: candidate_sha256, source_sha256: candidate_sha256}, {source_kind: SOURCE_ADMISSIBLE_MENU, source_id: source_state_sha256, source_sha256: menu_sha256}. The deterministic adapter will compute the strategy content hash. The independent verifier later decides eligibility for the complete candidate. No standalone-action effect is claimed by the initial-state training view. Use an empty array when no candidate is selected.

Review prior_closed_round_research_memory: accepted POST lessons and counterexplanations from CLOSED TRAIN rounds. Treat them as fallible research context, not current-round effect labels, proven general repairs, or authority to train/promote. Retain unresolved hypotheses and negative evidence when planning the next experiment.

Also return execution_contracts for EVERY selected EXECUTABLE_SHORT_OPTION, and none for exact actions.
This is the executable representation of the SAME complete selected candidate, not a new experiment or a shortened repair.
Copy source_candidate_sha256, source_state_sha256 and termination_condition exactly. Preserve all ordered option_actions.
Every contract has mandatory environment-done, next-action-not-in-live-menu and action-exhaustion stops, per-step native budget accounting, and return to frozen policy.
stop_predicates are OR-ed. MENU_COMMAND_PREFIX takes one exact command prefix ending with a space (e.g. a take command naming the target type).
OBSERVATION_ALL_SUBSTRINGS takes one or more literal substrings, ALL required in the current public observation; task-instruction lines are excluded. Do not use generic words that also match negative feedback.
PUBLIC_TARGET_VISIBLE and PUBLIC_TARGET_CARRIED take one lowercase object type, using the existing public observation/menu detectors.
PUBLIC_GOAL_COMPLETION takes the exact public_task_goal and uses the public environment-done boundary; use only when the termination objective is exactly the full task goal.
Live admissible commands enforce native action preconditions. No hidden environment state, reward, verifier output, future result or arbitrary code is available to the contract.
Set semantic_coverage FULL only when every termination clause is represented faithfully; explain the mapping in coverage_explanation.
Use UNREPRESENTABLE if the declared predicates cannot represent the complete option; never silently weaken or rewrite the candidate, and never claim partial semantics as FULL.
This annex is generated in this same PRE response and executed deterministically; there is no human runtime parser.

Use analyzer_evidence_view: it contains the registered current TRAIN failure census, public task context, local hypotheses with support and counterevidence, group mechanisms, component attributions, policy profiles and Formal-X scope. Review these with the governed Researcher Memory when selecting the principal bottleneck and experiment. These diagnoses are hypotheses, not causal effect labels.
